steps.text: Game board in the center; 9 ocean tiles on their reserved space
Temperature and oxygen markers on their starting positions; generation marker on 1
Resource cubes and remaining tiles within reach
Remove Corporate Era cards (red-and-white icon) from the project and corporation cards; shuffle the project deck beside the board
First player marker to the most recent winner
Each player: a color's markers and a player board, a marker on 1 of each production track, one on 20 of the TR track
New players: a Beginner Corporation each - they keep all 10 project cards for free
Everyone else: 2 corporation cards (from the 10 standard ones) and 10 project cards
Choose 1 corporation and which project cards to keep; discard the rest facedown
In player order: reveal your corporation, take its starting resources and production, pay 3 MegaCredits per card kept
The first player marker moves clockwise each generation
Generation 1 starts with the action phase
